name: DLMS Meter
description: The `dlms_meter` component connects to smart meters which use the **DLMS/COSEM** protocol in PUSH mode over UART. These smart meters are widely deployed globally.

config_entries.label: UART ID
config_entries.description: The ID of the UART component that is connected to the smart meter.

config_entries.label: Auth Key
config_entries.description: Authentication key. Specify if your smart meter uses encryption with authentication. You should request this key from your electricity provider. Used for `General-GLO-Ciphering` and `General-DED-Ciphering` APDUs.

config_entries.label: Custom Patterns
config_entries.description: While the `dlms_meter` natively supports most devices, some meters use unique payload structures. If your meter's data isn't being read correctly, use this field to define a **custom AXDR descriptor pattern** that tells the system how to parse the incoming data.

config_entries.label: Default Obis
config_entries.description: The fallback OBIS code to use if the pattern captures no OBIS code. Requires **name** to be set. Formatted like `1-0:96.1.0` or `1.0.96.1.0.255`.

config_entries.label: Priority
config_entries.description: The priority of the pattern (lower number is tried first). Defaults to `0`.

config_entries.label: Decryption Key
config_entries.description: Specify if your smart meter uses encryption. You should request this key from your electricity provider (32 hex characters, case-insensitive).

config_entries.label: Receive Timeout
config_entries.description: The timeout for receiving a complete frame. Defaults to `1000ms`.

config_entries.label: Skip CRC
config_entries.description: Skip CRC check. Some smart meters use the wrong polynomial to calculate CRC. In such cases, you can use this flag as a workaround. Defaults to `false`.
